EmailTemplate.name: Reminder: Summer Music Theory Course Registration Information
EmailTemplate.subject: Reminder: Summer Music Theory Course Registration Information
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
We are looking forward to welcoming you to the ASU Tempe Campus in August as a music major! Because your theory diagnostic exam score was below the minimum required to begin the MTC 125 Basic Music Theory course, you are required to complete the Fundamentals of Music Notation online course with a final grade of C or better this summer. At this time you have not started the course.
Please email musicadmissions@asu.edu to inform us that you have completed the course and the final exam.
**Please note that you will be un-enrolled from MTC 125 if you do not complete this course in its entirety by August 1, 2015 at 12:00 p.m.**
In order for you to remain enrolled in MTC 125 Basic Music Theory for the fall semester, login with your ASURITE credentials and access the course by the following link:
https://herbergeronline2.asu.edu/musicfundamentalsR/
Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions about the contents of this email.
Sincerely,
Julie Stephens Coordinator, Academic Affairs + Admissions Arizona State University | Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts P.O. Box 870405 | Tempe, Arizona 85287-0405 Phone: 480-965-5069 {!Case.Thread_Id}
